synth.notes: Blocks move on a 4-grid: A1/A2 y+/-4 both, A3 apart, A4 together; blocked by invisible maze cells {(6,18),(14,38),(22,18),(38,14)} and marker cells (pos-1) — (22,18) is the cell the committee missed (step 124: block_left 18->22 blocked while block_right 34->30 moved). Clicks: inactive marker arms (blocks->color_1 players, marker->color_11 active; A1-4 steer it), second inactive switches, player disarms, active/block/empty = no-op; A5/A7 no-op. Timer n ticks every action; bars wall_0 at (64-w,0),(0,63), w=3(n+1)//7; continuity-gated, fallback n = largest with observed w (top of band) else 0 — gives n=47->48 for the w 20->21 step. Names = type_color_rank by (y,x), ranks 2+ in block mode, 0+ armed; ranking mode computed from the AFTER state. Unconfirmed: A7, clicks on empty cells, marker/marker collision.
